# Setup

Direct effects are zero, with parental variance targets of 0.5% and 1%
and 400 phenotype replicates per condition.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(data.table)
library(knitr)

parental_variances <- c(0.005, 0.01)
result_root <- "results/simulation"
```

# Phenotypes and GWAS

```{r}
#| label: run-simulation
if (params$rerun) {
  source("simulation.R")
  data <- load_simulation_data()
  for (v in parental_variances) {
    run_null_study(data, v, params$n_replicates,
                   file.path(result_root, paste0("parental_", v)))
  }
}
```

# FDR and p-value calibration

Empirical FDR is the proportion of replicates with at least one BH rejection
at 0.05. Population Z is also evaluated against the direct-effect null.

```{r}
method_names <- c(npmle = "RB-NPMLE", parametric = "RB-Normal",
                  direct_z = "Direct-effect", population_z = "Population-effect")
if (params$rerun) {
  for (name in c("summary.tsv", "pvalue_tails.tsv")) {
    tables <- lapply(parental_variances, function(v) {
      path <- file.path(result_root, paste0("parental_", v), name)
      data.table(parental_variance = v, fread(path))
    })
    fwrite(rbindlist(tables), file.path(result_root, name), sep = "\t")
  }
}
results_available <- all(file.exists(file.path(result_root,
                                               c("summary.tsv", "pvalue_tails.tsv"))))
if (results_available) {
  summary_table <- fread(file.path(result_root, "summary.tsv"))
  tail_table <- fread(file.path(result_root, "pvalue_tails.tsv"))
  kable(summary_table[, .(
    `Parental variance` = paste0(100 * parental_variance, "%"),
    Method = unname(method_names[method]),
    FDR = sprintf("%.4f", fdr),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.4f, %.4f)", fdr_ci_lower, fdr_ci_upper),
    `P(p < 0.05)` = sprintf("%.4f", p_lt_0_05_proportion)
  )])
} else {
  cat("No simulation results yet. Prepare the inputs as described in README.md,\n",
      "then run: quarto render simulation.qmd\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (results_available) {
  kable(tail_table[, .(
    `Parental variance` = paste0(100 * parental_variance, "%"),
    Method = unname(method_names[method]), Threshold = threshold,
    Proportion = signif(proportion, 4),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.5f, %.5f)", ci_lower, ci_upper)
  )])
}
```
